findings.summary: The kit's card validator implements no `additionalProperties`, so undeclared keys — including __proto__/constructor/prototype — pass validation against every schema, and the app polices prototype-pollution keys itself before rendering a card. The exclusion is written down only in a kit source comment (primitives/card-validate-schemas.ts); a consumer cannot derive that cards.validate() leaves undeclared keys unexamined.

attribution.fact: cardSchemas validation does not implement additionalProperties, so undeclared keys in model-produced card data are never a validation failure; the consumer must reject pollution keys themselves and nothing derivable says so
